newsitem.title: USA: CSCE cocoa ends weaker again, but tone subdued.
newsitem.headline: CSCE cocoa ends weaker again, but tone subdued.

text.p: CSCE cocoa prices fell for the third straight day Wednesday, hit by continued speculative selling, traders said.
Benchmark December delivery slid $11 a tonne on the day, to close at $1,343, just off its session low of $1,342. Spot September also eased $11, while the outer months fell $6 to $7.

December cocoa has fallen $30 a tonne since last Friday, when the market rebounded from an intraday five-month low with a 50-point rally. But dealers said the market's performance over the past three days likely signaled a return to the $1,320 area.
